scenario: LGRA.4.1 / LSCP.1.6 — the retired value-introducer colon form `const NAME: <literal>` is a compile error with a guided message; `:` introduces an optional type annotation and `=` introduces the value. Pin: `const HEAT: 75` rejects with DS_VALIDATE_CONST_COLON_LITERAL_RETIRED.
rules_ds:
const HEAT: 75

schema Sensor scope logical:
    state: Int key

rule r:
    Sensor s where s.state > HEAT
->
    log info "x"
